meta.title: 24点进房流程 · 快速匹配（游戏侧）

messages.label: ConnectGameSvr.connectGame(data) → AuthGame.req(addr, gatewayUrl, gameid, roomid)
messages.note: 承接大厅侧 s2c gameRoomReady；DataCenter 记录 gameid/roomid/gameAddr

messages.label: WS连接: gatewayUrl?ver=1&userid&gameid&roomid&token(DES加密)
messages.note: AuthGame 用 token 做 DES 加密登录串；先 loadProtocol("game10003")

messages.label: handshake→getGame(gameid, roomid)；auth前 connectGame(userid, gameid, roomid, client_fd)
messages.note: 先建房内 fd 绑定，再认证

messages.label: CMD.connectGame → room:connectGame(userid, fd) 绑定客户端fd
连接成功 onOpen → agentReady(null) → AuthGame.resp(true)
sendClientReady() → c2s clientReady {}
messages.note: game10003 c2s 协议号4；onConstruct 后延迟发送

messages.label: REQUEST:clientReady(userid) → 状态 LOADING→READY
messages.note: 匹配房 clientReady 即置 READY；房间未开始时 testStart

messages.label: s2c roomInfo {gameid, roomid, playerids, gameData, owner}
s2c playerInfos {infos}
messages.note: 协议号4；含昵称/头像/战力/状态

messages.label: s2c playerEnter {userid, seat}
messages.note: 协议号5；自己与其他玩家进入

messages.label: 全员READY → testStart → startGame → s2c gameStart(31)/stepId(32)/dealCards(33)

cards.title: 分支与异常
items: 认证失败：wsGameGate auth 返回 false，连接被拒
断线重连：GAME_SOCKET_DISCONNECT → 弹窗回大厅
重连恢复：clientReady → room:relink(userid)（见「私房与重连」图）

cards.title: 状态机要点
items: 匹配房全员 READY 才 startGame；房间超时 8s(等待连接)/300s(对局)
